steps.name: ImportLatestDesign
steps.label: Import latest design
steps.goal: Import any "views" identified in the latest design publish
steps.pass_criteria: one or more png files are copied to the current source files directory
steps.fail_criteria: no files are copied to the current source files directory
steps.min_scenario: You dig through the project/library folders by hand to find the latest published version, confirm it's the right one, and bring it in — when the folders are tidy and it's where it should be.
steps.max_scenario: The published version isn't where it should be, is the wrong one, or was never published — you Slack/email whoever touched it last, wait, maybe walk the building, and the task stalls for days.

steps.name: Create1024HighImages

steps.fail_criteria: we don't have any images on source_1024

steps.name: CheckTrainingData
steps.label: Check Training Data
steps.goal: Checks the training data to ensure all cards are approved.
steps.pass_criteria: all cards in the training data are approved
steps.fail_criteria: if any cards in training data are not approved.
steps.min_scenario: You eyeball the asset against the checklist by hand — naming, scale, topology, etc. — when it's clean and there's nothing to fix.
steps.max_scenario: You miss something (or there's a lot to fix); it ships, breaks in a downstream department, and bounces back days later for a re-publish.

steps.name: RenderLora
steps.label: Render LoRA
steps.goal: Submits our training data to Deadline in order to create a LoRA from it.
steps.fail_criteria: no job id is returned from deadline.
steps.min_scenario: You do the cleanup by hand before handing off — quick when you remember it.
steps.max_scenario: You forget or do it wrong; the mistake ships in the file and gets flagged downstream, forcing a redo.

steps.name: PrepCharacterLora
steps.label: Prep Character LoRA
steps.goal: prep a character lora from a character sheet or multiple images.

steps.name: CaptionCharacterSet
steps.label: Caption Character Set
steps.goal: Auto-caption every image in a character LoRA set using the vision model, writing .txt sidecars.
steps.pass_criteria: Every image in the set has a .txt caption beside it.
steps.fail_criteria: Any image is left without a caption, or a caption is empty.

steps.name: CheckForReviewFiles
steps.label: Check For Review Files
steps.goal:
Locate the render image sequence to review (prefers ``playblast``) and
stash its printf pattern + frame range in shared_data for downstream steps.
steps.min_scenario: You set up the camera/settings and capture the media by hand, then drop it where reviewers look — when it works first try.
steps.max_scenario: Settings are off or reviewers can't find it; you re-capture and re-share, and review slips.

steps.name: CheckForExistingReview
steps.label: Check For Existing Review

whether a tracker Version already exists for this context.

steps.name: AddDescription
steps.label: Add Description
steps.goal:
Ensure a version description is set.

Headless/farm-safe: the description comes from shared_data (set by the
trigger / UI before the recipe runs); we don't pop a dialog here. Falls
back to a sensible default so the review never blocks.

The standard intermediate (handles EXR → predictable HD PNG) downstream
